policies: External providers record positive evidence only. A missing page, row, field, result, language, region, card, or finish remains unknown.
Authority tier and card-existence capability never imply finish completeness or absence authority.
A grading registry, collector registry, marketplace image, owner attestation, or inspected specimen may establish only the concrete positive record it identifies.
Every retained observation keeps its query URL and parameters, retrieval date, source record, and a generated SHA-256 content hash.
Unavailable, incomplete, rate-limited, and browser-blocked surfaces remain visible graph nodes; their failure state must not be converted into a negative verdict.

An exact retained PokéCottage row is tier-3 positive confirmation for the facts it states. Facts demonstrably shared by an already identified matching Western release may corroborate that release when the equivalence basis is retained; omissions and unstated alternatives never establish absence or completeness.
